verdict.rationale: Jev documents versioned model IDs (jev-1.13.0), stable/preview aliases with guidance to pin versions for consumers who tuned thresholds, and per-version release dates via the /v1/models endpoint, giving a de facto migration path. However, there is no explicit deprecation policy (e.g., sunset timelines, advance-notice window, EOL dates for old versions) or a changelog of breaking API changes beyond SDK-level changelog mentions. missing for 10: explicit deprecation/sunset timeline commitments, advance-notice policy for retiring model versions, and independent/community confirmation that old versions remain callable after a new release.
